# Complex Identity Cutover Programme

The customer portal, billing gateway, reporting warehouse, and legacy adapter all require the
Identity Platform before the May release can proceed.

The Customer Portal plan states it is ready for direct legacy cutover. The Legacy Adapter section
states that direct cutover is not supported and manual reconciliation is required until remediation
is complete.

Identity Platform remediation runs from 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-24. The cutover rehearsal is scheduled
for 2026-05-20 to 2026-05-21 and must start after Identity Platform remediation is complete.
